title: Travel Booking Platform
summary: A Laravel travel booking platform with an advanced search layer using Node.js and MongoDB to aggregate real-time results from multiple APIs.
challenge: Travel searches needed to aggregate results from multiple APIs while remaining fast and responsive for users.
solution: Built both backend and frontend of the travel booking platform using Laravel.
Developed an advanced search feature using Node.js and MongoDB.
Integrated multiple APIs for real-time travel results.
Optimized the search workflow for faster deal discovery.
outcomes: Users could see real-time results from multiple APIs.
